How the proposed bb-plugin-hermes v1 works

Long image

A

Answer

Each chat with an enabled Hermes bot becomes a bb thread. bb sends through the Hermes gateway's queue, so bb and Conduit share one conversation.

  1. A plugin bridge on the Hermes machine carries each bb chat to the gateway; replies stream back live.1
  2. bb and Conduit add turns to the same Bot Chat; bb waits instead of forking when Conduit holds it.2
  3. Chats started in CLI, TUI, Desktop or Conduit appear in bb by themselves.1
  4. One switch per bot turns all of this on, including the bot's access to bb.3

Applies toProposed v1 for any Hermes user, awaiting the owner's OK (Q22). Bot names are examples. Open items are marked TBD.

1

What runs where?

Diagram structure
  • bb app app
  • bb server bb
  • Plugin server server
  • Plugin bridge bridge
  • Host worker worker
  • Hermes gateway gateway
  • Bots bots
  • Saved chats saved
  • app → bb · message · reply
  • server → bb
  • server → worker · host calls
  • bb → bridge · turn · reply
  • bridge → gateway · send · stream
  • worker → gateway · watches
  • gateway → bots · runs turn
  • gateway → saved · saves
  • The plugin has three parts: a server part on the bb server, and a host worker plus one bridge per open chat on the Hermes machine.
  • The worker and each bridge have their own connection to the gateway. The bb server never touches Hermes files.4
2

How do the other Hermes apps connect?

Diagram structure
  • Conduit conduit
  • Dashboard dashboard
  • Desktop desktop
  • Saved chats saved
  • Gateway gateway
  • CLI / TUI cli
  • conduit → dashboard · sends
  • dashboard → saved · runs, saves
  • dashboard → gateway · if busy
  • desktop → gateway · sends
  • gateway → saved
  • cli → saved · saves
  • Conduit reaches Hermes through the dashboard. The dashboard runs Conduit's turn itself, or hands it to the gateway queue when the chat is busy.2
  • Desktop on the Hermes machine talks to the gateway directly; CLI and TUI chats land in saved chats.
3

What happens in a chat from bb?

Diagram structure
  • You send send
  • Gateway queue queue
  • Bot runs it run
  • Reply streams stream
  • Bot asks ask
  • Card + push card
  • You answer answer
  • Turn goes on goon
  • send → queue · send
  • queue → run · runs
  • run → stream · streams
  • run → ask · may ask
  • ask → card
  • card → answer
  • answer → goon · answer
  • You pick a bot, a model and a reasoning level. The bot stays fixed for the whole chat.1
  • Approvals and questions show as a card in bb and send a push. bb never approves for you.
4

How does Stop work?

Diagram structure
  • You tap Stop tap
  • Turn stops stop
  • Shows stopped shown
  • Conduit's turn conduit
  • tap → stop · stop
  • stop → shown · ended
  • Stop works on bb's own turns and on Conduit messages handed to the gateway queue.5
5

How do bb and Conduit share one Bot Chat?

Diagram structure
  • bb sends bbsend
  • Conduit sends csend
  • Dashboard dash
  • Gateway queue queue
  • Saved chat saved
  • Streams in bb live
  • Shows in bb later
  • bbsend → queue · find Bot Chat
  • csend → dash
  • dash → queue · busy
  • dash → saved · idle: runs
  • queue → live · streams
  • saved → later · read (TBD)
  • The bot's pinned bb thread is its Bot Chat, found by title each time. Nothing forks or gets copied.5
  • Conduit's own turns show in bb in two steps: your message at once, the reply when the turn ends.2
6

What if Conduit holds the chat?

Diagram structure
  • bb sends send
  • Refused held
  • bb waits wait
  • Conduit lets go free
  • Gateway runs it adopt
  • Reply streams reply
  • send → held · send
  • held → wait · busy
  • wait → adopt · retry
  • free → adopt
  • adopt → reply · streams
  • bb shows "Open in Conduit: sends when it's free" and retries. It never creates a second chat.5
7

Which outside chats show up in bb?

Diagram structure
  • CLI, TUI local
  • Conduit conduit
  • Discord etc. chatapps
  • Cron, one-shot cron
  • Saved chats saved
  • Not in bb out
  • Plugin sorts plugin
  • 30-day import import
  • Live mirror live
  • bb threads threads
  • Unread, push unread
  • local → saved
  • conduit → saved
  • chatapps → saved
  • cron → saved
  • saved → plugin · read (TBD)
  • plugin → out
  • plugin → import · 30 days
  • plugin → live · new turns
  • import → threads
  • live → threads
  • live → unread · outside
  • In: every chat of an enabled bot from CLI, TUI, Desktop and Conduit. The last 30 days are imported once.1
  • Out: cron and one-shot runs. Discord and other chat apps are proposed out (Q23).1
8

What does the per-bot switch do?

Diagram structure
  • Bot switch switch
  • bb server bb
  • Host worker worker
  • bb skill skill
  • bb-hermes wrapper
  • Bot bot
  • switch → worker · on / off
  • worker → skill · writes, deletes
  • worker → wrapper
  • bot → skill · uses
  • skill → wrapper
  • wrapper → bb · runs bb
  • On: chat in bb, mirroring, and full access to bb. The bot's bb skill calls one bb-hermes wrapper on the Hermes machine.6
  • Off: the bot is absent from bb, and the worker deletes its skill. Every bot starts off (proposed).7
9

What is still open?

To be decided in the plan rewrite

How v1 reads Hermes history for the 30-day import and for Conduit's turns. D40 predates full mirroring. When the 30-day import runs for a bot switched on later, and what happens to a bot's bb threads when it is switched off.
